limitations: No Google API / CrUX / GSC / GA4 credentials: performance is lab-only, no ranking or traffic data
PageSpeed Insights rate-limited: no Lighthouse Agentic Browsing fraction
No DataForSEO or Moz: no referring-domain data
Initial crawler followed redirects silently; redirect-related findings were re-verified with curl

summary.business_type: Affiliate publisher: Australian smart-home guides + product catalogue (non-local, research-based, no hands-on testing)
top_findings: Article bylines are assigned at random by the writer script (generate-post.ts) and author pages contradict the bylines - deceptive-authorship risk
About 45 affiliate buy buttons on ~63 pages point to /goto?url=..., which returns 404
47 of 84 articles cite no sources, including electrical-safety / tenancy / legal topics, contradicting /how-we-test/
Mobile LCP 4.9-6.9s on all tested pages (lab); product pages also fail CLS (0.16-0.19) from an unsized hero image
Money queries ('best robot vacuum australia', 'best smart plug australia') want ranked lists; the site serves explainers with no picks tables
quick_wins: Fix the escaped-quote links in /security-and-cameras/door-window-sensors-entry-alerts/ via Payload admin (5 broken links)
Point internal links at canonical slash URLs (59 hrefs) and remove the 13 dead /articles/page/N/ links from /sitemap/ and 12 '//' links from /all-topics/
Remove the duplicated brand from titles and trim titles to <=60 chars in the title template
Add width/height + fetchPriority=high to the product hero image (fixes CLS on 230 URLs)
Shrink the mobile cookie banner from 39% of the viewport to a <=100px bar

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: http/www -> https apex in one hop
Wrong-category, legacy and no-slash URLs 308 to canonical
Valid robots.txt; sitemap of 336 URLs all 200 + indexable
Canonical, lang and single H1 on every page

findings.title: Dead /goto affiliate links
findings.description: 45 entries in app/public/data/products.json use /goto?url=CAES...; rendered as buy buttons on ~63 pages; /goto 308s to /goto/ then 404s. No route or nginx rule exists.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real retailer URLs in Payload Offers, or add a /goto route that validates and redirects to approved retailer hosts.

findings.title: Malformed escaped hrefs in one article
findings.description: door-window-sensors-entry-alerts body contains \"https:/... links producing 5 404 URLs; content lives in the Payload DB.
findings.recommendation: Edit the article in Payload admin; add a publish-time validation rejecting \" in Markdown bodies.

findings.title: Internal links to redirecting URLs
findings.description: 59 internal hrefs use no-slash or '//' forms (12 on /all-topics/), and /sitemap/ links 13 /articles/page/N/ URLs that 308 to /articles/.
findings.recommendation: Normalise hrefs to trailing-slash canonical form in the link helpers; drop pagination links from app/(frontend)/sitemap/page.tsx:96,140.

findings.title: 404 template emits conflicting robots tags
findings.description: Both noindex and 'index, follow', plus canonical to the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Emit only noindex on 404s and drop the canonical.

findings.title: Year-long s-maxage on product pages and /search/
findings.description: s-maxage=31536000; latent risk of stale prices if Cloudflare starts caching HTML.
findings.recommendation: Use s-maxage=300 + stale-while-revalidate like articles.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod partly synthetic
findings.description: 169 product URLs carry bulk-import timestamps; 7 CMS pages share one save time; hubs inherit newest-article date.
findings.recommendation: Use real content-modified dates only.

findings.title: ads.txt 404, short HSTS, no CSP, x-powered-by leak
findings.description: Security/monetisation hygiene.
findings.recommendation: Publish ads.txt when AdSense is enabled; HSTS 1y + includeSubDomains; remove x-powered-by.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Honest trust pages: research-only, AI drafting disclosed on /about/, 'has not tested' on products
Articles since 7 Oct have Sources sections and government links
Product pages are not copy-paste (3-7% shared text)
Affiliate notice above the fold on articles

findings.title: Random author bylines
findings.description: generate-post.ts picks the author via Math.random(); author bios claim articles bylined to someone else; no credentials or sameAs for any author.
findings.recommendation: Assign authors deliberately (or use an editorial-team byline), reconcile author pages, add real credentials; confirm all named authors are real people.

findings.title: Unsourced articles on YMYL-adjacent topics
findings.description: 47/84 articles have no editorial outbound links; 42 electrical/privacy/tenancy articles cite no official source.
findings.recommendation: Back-fill a Sources block with regulator links, starting with the electrical-work and tenancy articles.

findings.title: Titles over-promise
findings.description: e.g. 'Home Battery Rebate 2026' never names the programme; 'Real Numbers' running-costs article gives no figure.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite or retitle; add concrete AU figures with sources.

findings.title: Scaled-content pattern
findings.description: 18 articles published in 4 minutes on 23 Aug; 41 share one dateModified; unlabeled AI hero images.
findings.recommendation: Stagger publishing, only bump dateModified on real edits, label AI imagery.

findings.title: Non-AU products and a safety contradiction
findings.description: Aqara H1 EU switch recommended though its page says it won't fit AU boxes; kettle automation suggested though another article says not to.
findings.recommendation: Remove non-AU picks; reconcile safety advice.

findings.title: Cannibalisation
findings.description: 5 overlapping smart-plug articles; 3 near-identical lighting-scene articles.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate and 301 the weaker URLs.

findings.title: Meta descriptions too long
findings.description: 224 descriptions >160 chars (product median 328).
findings.recommendation: Cap the product description template at ~155 chars.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles on all canonical pages
Strong internal linking: 0 orphan sitemap URLs

findings.title: Titles too long
findings.description: 385 of 421 titles exceed 60 chars; some repeat the brand ('NXT Smart Home AU | NXT Smart Home').
findings.recommendation: Shorten the template suffix; drop duplicate brand.

findings.title: Product H1s drop the brand
findings.description: e.g. 'Hub M100' rather than 'Aqara Hub M100'.
findings.recommendation: Prefix brand in product H1 and title.

findings.title: Default OG data on product pages
findings.description: All product pages use the default og:title and og-default.png; share links point to the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Emit per-product og:title, og:image and share URLs.

findings.title: Noindexed category linked sitewide
findings.description: /categories/smart-door-locks/ is noindex,follow but linked from 421 pages.
findings.recommendation: Either populate and index it or remove it from navigation.

findings.title: SearchAction targets a disallowed URL
findings.description: Emitted on all pages; /search/ is robots-disallowed and the sitelinks search box is retired.
findings.recommendation: Remove SearchAction.

findings.title: Offer URLs are affiliate redirects
findings.description: geni.us and tracked eBay URLs in Offer.url; some price ranges mix variants/sellers.
findings.recommendation: Use canonical retailer product URLs; add itemCondition; exclude mismatched listings.

findings.title: Static pages lack page schema
findings.description: about, contact, how-we-test, disclosure etc. have no page-level schema or breadcrumb.
findings.recommendation: Add AboutPage/ContactPage/WebPage + BreadcrumbList.

findings.title: Weak entity linking
findings.description: Organization sameAs only Facebook; Person has no sameAs/image; Article author has no @id.
findings.recommendation: Add @id links and sameAs profiles.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0 on home, listings and articles

findings.title: Mobile LCP fails on all tested pages (lab)
findings.description: 4.9-6.9s; render-blocking 60KB CSS; home LCP image has no fetchpriority and loads at 2x the needed width.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS; set fetchPriority='high' explicitly and tighten sizes.

findings.title: Product page CLS
findings.description: 0.158-0.191 from the unsized hero at app/(frontend)/products/[slug]/page.tsx:157-161 (230 URLs).
findings.recommendation: Add width/height/aspect-ratio and fetchPriority='high'.

findings.title: 5,975 images without dimensions
findings.description: Product cards, retailer lists, article images.
findings.recommendation: Use next/image or explicit dimensions.

findings.title: JavaScript cost
findings.description: ~23 scripts / ~560KB per page; TBT 164-326ms mobile.
findings.recommendation: Lazy-load search, audio, aside and cookie-banner components.

findings.title: HTML not edge-cached
findings.description: cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC despite s-maxage=300.
findings.recommendation: Add a Cloudflare Cache Rule for HTML (bypass on admin/preview cookies).

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Newer articles open with a direct answer

findings.title: No comparison tables on vs/best pages
findings.description: Only 1 of 15 sampled comparison/buying articles has an HTML table.
findings.recommendation: Template a comparison table for every vs/best/buying-guide page.

findings.title: Thin brand/author entity footprint
findings.description: sameAs only Facebook; no author profiles beyond the site; brand searches return other companies.
findings.recommendation: Build Organization/Person sameAs, author credentials, and off-site profiles.

findings.title: Firewall contradicts robots.txt
findings.description: Cloudflare 403s GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Amazonbot etc. while robots.txt allows all.
findings.recommendation: Decide policy; align robots.txt; consider allowing Amazonbot (Alexa).

findings.title: Unlabelled interactive card overlays
findings.description: 12 unnamed links on home, 22 on an article.
findings.recommendation: aria-label or aria-hidden + tabindex=-1 on duplicate overlay anchors.

findings.title: No llms.txt / Markdown delivery
findings.description: Optional; Google ignores llms.txt.
findings.recommendation: Optional: publish llms.txt.

findings.title: Missing width/height
findings.description: 5,975 of 8,794 images (3,089 of 3,584 product images).
findings.recommendation: Add dimensions.

findings.title: AI hero images with garbled text
findings.description: Visible nonsense text in guide and home card heroes; unlabeled AI imagery.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate without text or use real photos; label AI images.

findings.title: Low-res white-background product cut-outs on dark theme
findings.description: Render as white boxes.
findings.recommendation: Use transparent PNG/WebP or a light card.

findings.title: 1,852 empty alt attributes
findings.description: Fine for decorative images; verify product/card images are not among them.
findings.recommendation: Audit empty-alt images for meaningful content.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix random author assignment and reconcile author pages; confirm authors are real
Repair or replace the 45 /goto affiliate links
Fix escaped-quote links in door-window-sensors article
Fix product hero CLS and LCP priority
Fix mobile overflow on guide template; shrink cookie banner

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Back-fill Sources on electrical/tenancy/legal articles
Add comparison/picks tables to vs/best/buying guides
Create /robot-vacuums/best-robot-vacuum-australia/
Inline critical CSS; set explicit fetchPriority; lazy-load non-critical JS
Normalise internal links; remove dead pagination links
Shorten titles; cap meta descriptions; brand in product H1s; per-product OG

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Consolidate cannibalising smart-plug and lighting-scene articles with 301s
Rewrite over-promising titles with sourced AU figures
Remove non-AU product picks and reconcile safety advice
Build Organization/author sameAs and off-site presence
Add page schema to static pages; remove SearchAction; clean Offer URLs

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google API key for CrUX/GSC/PSI and re-run audit
Create a drift baseline
Decide AI crawler policy and align robots.txt with Cloudflare
Stagger publishing; only bump dateModified on real edits
